scope: Single-pass local retrieval comparison on authored development questions. No tuning after observing results; no FPT, Neo4j network, model training, clinical validation, full API evaluation or dotenv loading.

inventory.retriever: word TF-IDF + character TF-IDF + LSA32 + graph evidence
inventory.semantic_method: latent semantic analysis; not a neural embedding model

metric_definition: First matching named gold among top 1/top 3 ranked chunks. Document gold uses each chunk document_id without document deduplication. Missing or abstained evidence scores zero. This measures named evidence retrieval, not truth.
timing_scope: Same in-memory index/cache; baseline then adaptive per question; single measured pass, two BLAS threads. Includes adaptive checks; excludes index creation. These durations are not production latency/SLA or a repeated performance benchmark.

parameters.adaptive: unchanged adaptive-evidence-2.1, at most 3 retrieve calls, k=4
